_doc: Doc-consumption registry (owner, 2026-11-12: nobody reads documents; the system runs on code). `python3 -m foundation docs_audit --check` fails when a tracked .md/.txt/.rst file has no consumer. Tiers: agent-instruction import, exact path named by code/data, front matter generated-by/consumer, a row below (consumer file must exist, be a non-document, and contain the needle), or the knowledge tier (foundation/kb.py ranks these for every issue the executor works). A new document declares its consumer in front matter (`consumer: path`) or gets a row here in the same PR. A document that tells a person to act is a defect: file an automatic backlog item (owner, trigger, verification) instead. Removed documents stay in `removed` with their sha256 and the commit that holds them.

consumers.how: foundation/semrel.py writes it from Conventional Commits; the openstd workflow lands it with the version tag (OPEN-STANDARDS-1)
REUSE 3.3: seed/scripts/surfaces.py renders each licence text from LICENSE for the identifier ultrastable.json names, and reads it back on every --check (REPO-CONFORM-2)
GitHub renders these; brand/tools/sync_repos.py writes and brandcheck lints the brand blocks
brand/tools/generate.py reads the palette from it
foundation/brandcheck.py compares every repo block to these
positioning check scans the public profile
docs_audit --check requires the template to carry the consumer front matter
writeback record writes them, writeback check requires them with code changes
issue files are written by writeback and read by the cockpit
scaffold copies the seed kernel into every new system
selfdescribe reads SELF.md and the roles
promote --kits renders them from forms and facts and promote --check fails on any byte of drift
the retired demo tenant's idea file; the move plan records it as redeployed by its own bootstrap (ACCOUNT-SPLIT-3)
the paste-in prompt is read and asserted by the agent-setup test (path relative to the folded workers tree, so the exact-path tier missed it after REPOS-1)
the test boots the seed on this IDEA.md and asserts the system test passes and the objectives are seeded

DEPTH-1 seeds: seedlife lists every instances/<slug> with an IDEA.md as a seed and keeps a Q-SEED item until it is built, deployed and autonomous; ideas --check fails if a seed idea's IDEA.md is missing

knowledge.how: foundation/kb.py ranks these for every issue; foundation/executor.py build_prompt adds the best matches to the agent's prompt
